title: Incidence equivalence, a survey
summary: This is a survey of results on incidence equivalence, a notion introduced by P$.$Griffiths around 1970 when trying to extend the classical properties of the Abel-Jacobi map for curves. Using the intermediate jacobians and the associated Abel-Jacobi maps in higher dimension, a natural question came up: is the geometrically defined incidence equivalence relation the same as Abel-Jacobi equivalence, which is of transcendental nature?
